extDesc.message: Downloads shows, movies and YouTube videos as MP4 with every audio track, and subtitles as SRT.

err_no_subtitles.message: No subtitles were found on this page.

playlist_summary.message: Add the playlist to the queue

season_summary.message: Add the season to the queue

btn_clear_done.message: Remove finished jobs from the list

target_line.description: {path} is the full output file path.

audio_all_included.message: Every audio track in the video is included.

subs_none.message: No subtitles found. If you turn on subtitles in the player, the extension captures them too.

status_playlist_page.message: This is a playlist page. Add the list to the queue below.

status_yt_probing.message: Checking the YouTube video... (takes a few seconds)

btn_add_videos.message: Add the selected videos to the queue

status_open_yt.message: Open a YouTube video or playlist.

status_no_video.message: No video found on this page yet. Press play in the player, or start it with the button below.
status_no_video.description: A button that starts the player appears below this text.

status_sources_unreadable.message: The captured addresses could not be read. Reload the page and play the video. {why}
status_sources_unreadable.description: {why} is an optional technical reason in parentheses, may be empty.

add_failed.message: Could not add to the queue: {error}

episodes_none.message: No episode links found on this page. Open a page that shows the episode list of the series.

btn_add_episodes.message: Add the selected episodes to the queue

season_hint.message: The extension opens each episode in a small window in the background to find the video address. Do not close that window.
season_hint.description: Shown under the episode list when queueing a season.

resolve_waiting.message: Page open, waiting for the player · {sec} / {max} s

resolve_short_only.message: A short video was found, waiting for the episode · {sec} / {max} s

err_episode_interrupted.message: The search stopped before it ended (the browser or the helper program closed). Retry.

resolver_title.message: ReelHeist · {n} episodes searching · do not close this window

err_link_expired.message: The link has expired. "Try again" opens the page and refreshes the addresses.
err_link_expired.description: Shown when the stream address stopped working.

err_drm.message: This video is protected with DRM and cannot be downloaded.

err_no_quality.message: The chosen quality was not found in the playlist.

err_not_hls.message: The source is not a valid video playlist.

err_ffmpeg_missing.message: ffmpeg was not found. Run install.ps1 and try again.

err_ytdlp_missing.message: The YouTube component (yt-dlp) could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection.

err_ytdlp_failed.message: YouTube did not give the video. Try again later.

err_live.message: Live streams cannot be downloaded. Try again when the stream has ended.

err_bad_segment.message: The server sends corrupt video parts. Try again later.

err_no_video.message: No usable video format was found.

err_internal.message: An unexpected error happened in the helper program.

err_helper_missing.message: The helper program was not found. Run install.ps1, then restart the browser.

err_helper_no_reply.message: The helper program did not answer.

err_helper_unreachable.message: Could not connect to the helper program.

err_helper_outdated.message: The helper program is out of date. Install the latest version, then try again.

err_episode_unreadable.message: The captured video addresses could not be read.

err_episode_short.message: Only a short video was found (a trailer or an ad). The episode itself did not load.

warn_av_mismatch.message: Check the file: the lengths do not match ({detail}).

warn_subs_not_embedded.message: The subtitles could not be put inside the MP4; they are in the "srt" folder as .srt files.

downloading_close_hint.message: You can close the tab; the download continues in the background.

status_unsupported.message: No downloadable video on this page.

lbl_overlay.message: Show the "Download" button on the video player

set_overlay_hint.message: When it is off, open ReelHeist from the toolbar icon.

hint_audio_auto.message: Automatic: the interface language and the original language of the video.

hint_subs_auto.message: Automatic: the interface language, English and the original language of the video.

hint_embed_subs.message: VLC, phones and most TVs show them in the subtitle menu. The first subtitle language above turns on by itself.

hint_keep_srt.message: They go into an "srt" folder next to the MP4. When this is off, they are deleted after they are inside the MP4.

hint_folder_type.message: This helper version cannot open the folder picker. Type the folder path, then press Enter.

hint_site_memory.message: Your last quality, audio and subtitle choices on a site are remembered. On that site they are used instead of these defaults.

repo_trust_prompt.message: Do you trust this repository? Fingerprint: {fp}

err_repo_invalid.message: The repository format is not valid.

err_repo_untrusted.message: Trust the repository before installing packs.

err_pack_hash.message: Pack file hash did not match.

err_pack_not_found.message: Pack was not found in the repository.
